blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Ethereum block 26423424: current canonical supply is 105526365.307175497186410053 iTRY, owner() is Safe 0xbdb430adf64ff1c8201c10221ddb846fa62613b6 and its DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is true. transferState()=1 (WHITELIST_ENABLED). Ordinary transfers require WHITELISTED_ROLE on msg.sender, from and to; choosing a whitelisted counterparty alone does not permit an unwhitelisted holder to transfer. grantRole can directly mark any victim BLACKLISTED_ROLE, and redistributeLockedAmount can burn that victim balance and reissue it to a nonblacklisted target. The Safe need not hold BLACKLIST_MANAGER_ROLE to assign the target role directly. This is current direct Yes, independent of upgradeability. At MegaETH block 31986187 (2026-11-15T22:53:18Z), 797.490876 iTRY OFT is about 0.0007557% of canonical liabilities (peripheral, not added to monetary supply); owner() is the same-address three-of-five Safe and transferState()=2. Verified OFT owner methods also blacklist and redistribute holder balances. Ethereum is material even after excluding bridged locks; its direct controls decide the verdict. The DLF reserve claim would additionally terminate in issuer/fund custody, but no reserve-majority assumption is required for this direct verdict.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Canonical iTRY is issued on Ethereum. The Ethereum LayerZero OFT adapter locks native tokens and the MegaETH OFT mints representations on accepted messages. Both adapter and OFT are controlled by Brix’s same-address 3-of-5 Safe v1.4.1 (zero guard, empty modules, canonical CompatibilityFallbackHandler on both chains). At Ethereum block 26481235 and MegaETH block 32681089 (2026-11-23 UTC), an exhaustive 188-EID LayerZero V2 scan confirms sole reciprocal Ethereum (30101) ↔ MegaETH (30398) peers using custom SendLib/RecvLib, 0 required + 3-of-5 optional DVNs (LayerZero Labs, P2P, Horizen, Twinstake, USDT0), and a mutable built-in 250,000,000 iTRY / 3,600 s rate limit on each side. Satellite balances are representations of locked canonical liabilities, not an additional reserve asset.

oracleRisk.summary: The current iTryIssuer uses an administrator-replaceable DLF valuation oracle to calculate iTRY mint, redeem and yield amounts. At Ethereum block 26423424, oracle() returned 0x60a91420c98c8461e20e9a6dda555e21c7bdbffe. Verified issuer code permits an INTEGRATION_MANAGER_ROLE holder to replace that source, and the default administrator can grant the role. This establishes privileged valuation authority; the feed’s current signer, heartbeat, economic price and independent valuation provenance remain unverified.
